Class TopologyDiagram

java.lang.Object
com.eqixiac.equinix.design.export.TopologyDiagram
public class TopologyDiagram extends Object
Renders deployment topologies as Mermaid graph text. Mermaid renders natively on GitHub, GitLab, and many docs platforms, so the output is a portable, version-controllable diagram.

For a DeploymentPlan, each metro becomes a subgraph containing its Cloud Router(s); provider connections are drawn as edges from a router to an external provider node, and backbone links as edges between routers in different metros. For an OptimizationResult, metros are nodes annotated with their rank and score, optionally grouping the workloads placed in each metro.

Node labels are HTML-escaped (&, <, > and double quotes), so metro, router, provider and workload names containing markup-significant characters render literally instead of being interpreted by Mermaid's HTML label parser.

This class is stateless and thread-safe.
